answer: Trust flow on the vouch graph. Each agent is a vertex and each vouch is an edge backed by 500 POA, lost if the vouchee is slashed. At every close, trust starts at 100 seed agents and spreads by 4-step random walks, so a sybil farm only gets what leaks across its few edges to honest agents. A farm of 1,000 fakes joined by 5 attack edges shares about the trust of 5 real peers, and each new edge costs a real bond. Payout is capped by trust score, so no quill of clever prose or fable of busy history helps without honest edges.
